provenance.what: blind labels for bare-ASCII Vietnamese-headed author names: which token is the family name. Judges saw the raw string only, never any sinonym output.
provenance.judged: 2026-07-28. vn26: 306 items / 918 votes / 6 judges, stratified by token shape. vn26c: 397 names drawn with probability proportional to corpus mentions, 2 votes, 6 judges. vn26d: the same 397 names re-judged open-ended (no candidate answers offered), 2 votes, 6 judges.
provenance.agreement: the two instruments agreed on 383/384 shared names; attention checks 12/12 and 6/6; calibration against the stratified round 57/57 and 58/58
provenance.why_pps: accuracy on this population is mention-weighted by construction: under PPS the unweighted rate of the sample estimates the corpus rate, so no per-name rate is projected onto mentions
provenance.population: 23,462 names / 101,119 mentions route family-first under the 26-head relaxation; a further 9,144 names / 53,067 mentions are held back by the trailing-surname guard and are represented here too
provenance.known_residue: non-Vietnamese surnames in trailing position (Doan Perdana, Dam Sunwoo, Doan Nainggolan, Vo Ebuara), rare Vietnamese surnames trailing (Truong Nghiem, Truong Son Hy) and front-rotated records (Thuong Le Thi, Trinh Nguyen Duy). No shipped asset can identify these; see the discussion in the experiment log.
